title: The platform should follow from the interview format
takeaway: LeetCode fits the algorithmic screen; a take-home or debugging round needs different practice.
sources: The platform should follow from the format.
If you skip this step you will spend three months grinding array problems for a company whose entire process is a take-home plus a code walkthrough.
None of that is trainable on a problem site.
The mistake is not using LeetCode.

data.question: What interview are you preparing for?

branches.then: LeetCode, NeetCode or Codeforces, by pattern
branches.verdict: LeetCode is genuinely good at this

branches.then: Build something small and complete under a four-hour timer
branches.verdict: Scoping judgement is not trainable on a problem site
Reading existing code is a distinct skill
